title: Wellington (R1392) crash
memorial_details: Tall grey brick faced structure with a brass plaque attached.
inscription: HERE ON 27/27 MAY 1941/ A WELLINGTON BOMBER/ NZ-N OF 304 (Silesian) Squadron/ CRASHED AFTER BOMBING THE FRENCH/ PORT OF BOULOGNE WHERE IT HAD BEEN/ HIT AND BADLY DAMAGED/ CREW WHO DIED/ names (4)/ CREW WHO SURVIVED/ names (2)/ BAILED OUT
community_connection: Port of Boulogne where it had been hit and badly damaged
